title: Alignment
description: A multiple sequence alignment: a list of Sequence records. Conventionally all sequences have the same length once gaps are included, but that is a semantic constraint, not checked structurally by this schema. Deliberately NOT wrapped in an object with a wire-format 'type' discriminator (unlike tree/distance-matrix/blast-result): react-bio-viz's AlignedSequences and acacia's MSAData are both bare arrays today, and wrapping would break that wire shape for no current consumer.
